target.name: Cohen & Steers Global Income Builder, Inc.

announcement.quote: You are being asked to consider and vote upon a proposed transaction related to Cohen & Steers Global Income Builder, Inc. (“INB”) and Cohen & Steers Infrastructure Fund, Inc. (“UTF” and, together with INB, the “Funds” and each a “Fund”).

deals.notes: The N-14 says INB shares would be removed from listing on the NYSE, but no excerpt shows UTF's exchange listing, so both_listed is null. The excerpts show vote-solicitation 425s through 2019-11-20 for the 2019-11-15 INB meeting; none states the meeting result or how the reorganization ended. The 2020 and 2021 filings are annual-meeting materials of UTF and other funds and do not mention INB in the excerpts.
